evidence: Modifies `src/wallet/test/coinselector_tests.cpp` and `src/wallet/test/coinselection_tests.cpp` to modernize CoinGrinder coin selection unit tests.
rationale: Migrates CoinGrinder tests from the legacy suite to use realistic effective values and feerates rather than synthetic parameters. This improves test reliability and works toward consolidating coin selection testing, but it is an internal test refactor reasonably deferrable behind functional fixes.
